title: WEF Data Equity 2023 PDF affiliation closure depth 3
summary: The WEF-branded 2023 briefing-paper artifact is recoverable through arXiv and closes the fixed-roster affiliation gap: it names the 2023-2024 Global Future Council on Data Equity members and their publication-era roles, including Katherine Hsiao at Palantir and the previously unresolved David Kanamugire.

gaps: The official www3.weforum.org PDF endpoint still timed out during this pass, so no fresh hash of that endpoint was produced.
caveats: The arXiv-hosted PDF is a WEF-branded copy of the report and is used for contributor-page recovery; the official WEF publication page independently verifies title and publication date.
Council membership and listed employer affiliation do not establish that the employer institution authored, sponsored, or endorsed every statement in the paper.

provenance.method: official WEF publication verification plus arXiv-hosted WEF artifact contributor-page extraction

data.question: Can the 2023 WEF Data Equity artifact close the remaining publication-era affiliation and unresolved-author gaps?
data.method: Compare the official WEF publication metadata, arXiv author record, and the WEF-branded arXiv PDF contributor pages; preserve the unreachable official PDF endpoint as an artifact-retrieval caveat.
data.scope: Global Future Council on Data Equity 2023-2024 contributor roster and publication-era affiliations.
findings: The report's contributor section explicitly labels the roster as the Global Future Council on Data Equity 2023-2024.
The 22 arXiv-listed authors resolve to 19 named council members plus three World Economic Forum staff contributors: Supheakmungkol Sarin, Kimmy Bettinger and Stephanie Teeuwen.
Katherine Hsiao is listed as Executive Vice-President and Head of Health and Life Sciences at Palantir Technologies.
David Kanamugire is resolved as Chief Executive Officer of the National Cyber Security Agency of Rwanda.

JoAnn Stonier is listed as Mastercard Fellow, Data & AI, Mastercard; Lauren Woodman as Chief Executive Officer, DataKind; Majed Alshammari as Special Adviser, Data Governance, Saudi Data and AI Authority; Renée Cummings as Data Science Professor and Data Activist in Residence, University of Virginia; Nighat Dad as Founder and Executive Director, Digital Rights Foundation; and Arti Garg as AI Chief Strategist, Hewlett Packard Enterprise.

Alberto Giovanni Busetto is listed as Group Senior Vice-President and Head of Data and Artificial Intelligence, Adecco Group; Maui Hudson as Associate Professor and Director, Te Kotahi Research Institute, University of Waikato; Parminder Jeet Singh as Digital Society Researcher; Astha Kapoor as Co-Founder, Aapti Institute; and Zheng Lei as Professor, Fudan University.

Jacqueline Lu is listed as President and Co-Founder, Helpful Places; Emna Mizouni as Chief Executive Officer, Digital Citizenship; Angela Oduor Lungati as Executive Director, Ushahidi; María Paz Canales Loebel as Head of Legal, Policy and Research, Global Partners Digital; Arathi Sethumadhavan as User Research Scientist, Technology and Society, Google; and Sarah Telford as Lead, Centre for Humanitarian Data, UN OCHA.
The contributor page therefore replaces prior current-profile backdating uncertainty with direct October-2023 publication-era role evidence for the fixed council roster.
conclusions: The depth-3 target is closed: the 2023 publication-era affiliations are directly recoverable from the report artifact, and David Kanamugire is no longer unresolved.
Hsiao's Palantir affiliation is contemporaneous to the 2023 council output, but this remains a person-to-employer affiliation and not a corporate authorship claim.
limitations: No fresh SHA-256 was obtained for the official www3.weforum.org endpoint because that host timed out in this environment.
unresolved: Whether the 2024 follow-on report retained the same council roster and Palantir representation.
Exact corporate or institutional sponsorship, if any, should not be inferred from member employer labels.
